Verify required artifacts, review/QA results and platform-specific rollback evidence; missing or unrun inputs remain NOT ASSESSED or blocking as appropriate. In-session role review is not independent sign-off.

Evaluate only applicable device and cert-tier tracks. Verify actual build bytes with SHA-256 against a separately supplied expected digest; a matching hash establishes identity only, not a runnable build or passing QA. Missing build, bug records, tests, approvals, rollback or other required evidence prevents READY; distinguish known blockers from unknown checks.
